description: An expression that builds a list, set or dict from an iterable: `[x for x in items if ok(x)]`.
`keys()`, `values()` and `items()` return live views that reflect later changes to the dict.
`keys()` supports `&`, `|`, `-`, `^`, and so does `items()` when the values are hashable.
The loop variable lives in the comprehension's own scope and does not leak into the enclosing function.
`list(view)` copies the current contents, so later changes to the dict are not seen.
